question: At RH of about 59% and an evaporation temperature of 34 C, what share of droplets formed single crystals without the magnetic field and with it?
trap: the 31 C row (11.8 / 26.7) or the coffee-ring column
rendered:
According to the document, at RH ≈ 59% and evaporation temperature of 34 °C (zero field), the fraction of single-crystal deposits (ncr59 [%]) is 66.7%. 

At RH ≈ 59% and evaporation temperature of 34 °C (applied field), the fraction of single-crystal deposits (ncr59 [%]) is 58.8%.
